_help: Cloud watcher settings (no secrets here). Session times are PHT (24h) as in US summer time; from November to March, while New York is on winter time, the watcher runs them 1 hour later, like the app. Markets use MEXC's perpetuals, because your cTrader login never leaves your browser. maxAgeMin: how old a trigger can be and still be sent (GitHub's 5-minute schedule often runs late). headlines: market-moving headlines (the app's tags: GOLD, NDX, FED, USD, MACRO = data, tariffs, wars) newer than maxAgeMin are sent once.
